# Evergreen HAZWOPER

> HAZWOPER training for Washington State workers under WAC 296-843: 40-hour, 24-hour, remediation, refreshers and gas detection, with guides to dangerous waste and MTCA cleanups.

Evergreen HAZWOPER (https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, 8-Hour Refresher, Gas Detection training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour initial HAZWOPER, with the same hours Washington requires. Enroll: https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). The 24-hour HAZWOPER for occasional and low-exposure workers. Enroll: https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The standard annual 8-hour refresher. Enroll: https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Gas detection for excavations, vaults and confined spaces. Enroll: https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056

## Guides

- [WAC 296-843: Washington's HAZWOPER rule](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/guides/wac-296-843-washington-hazwoper): Washington writes its own HAZWOPER rule. What's the same as federal OSHA and what to watch for.
- [Dangerous waste in Washington: a broader definition](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/guides/dangerous-waste-in-washington): Washington calls it 'dangerous waste,' and it covers more than federal hazardous waste. What generators need to know.
- [MTCA cleanups: what Washington field crews should know](https://washington.hazwoperosha.us/guides/mtca-cleanups-for-field-crews): Most Washington cleanups run under the Model Toxics Control Act. The basics for crews on site.
